source: USDA FoodData Central (https://fdc.nal.usda.gov), public domain. Values are per 100 g of the food exactly as fdcDescription states. closestMatch=true means the shipped item is a packaged or branded product and the FDC entry is the closest match for that food, not a lab reading of the package. A null field means FoodData Central does not publish that value for the entry; it was not estimated. Nutrition capture for Phase V2-0; loaded by the app in Phase V2-6. Phase C2 (2026-10-27) added 35 entries for the expanded starter library, captured the same way; penne and lasagna noodles share the generic dry enriched pasta record (fdcId 169736) already used for spaghetti and rotini, flagged closestMatch.
